snippet.title: Slam Tank - Official Reveal Teaser Trailer
snippet.description: Watch the Reveal Teaser Trailer for Slam Tank, a hack-and-slash action beat 'em up developed by Next Stage Inc. Players will embody a single tank, ready to swing and slam straight into the opposition. Take on the AI machine army in Slam Tank, coming soon to PC (Steam).
